targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live_pilot_runs WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_endpoint_enrollments WHERE status = 'enrolled'
SELECT AVG(telemetry_continuity_pct) * 100 FROM live_telemetry_validations WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), COUNT(*) FROM pilot_endpoint_enrollments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), AVG(queue_lag) FROM live_telemetry_validations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT AVG(replay_recovery_success_pct) * 100 FROM pilot_health_checkpoints WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(drift_magnitude) FROM pilot_drift_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_rollback_audit WHERE status = 'pending_approval'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), COUNT(*) FROM pilot_operational_reviews WHERE verdict = 'acknowledged' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), AVG(telemetry_gap_rate) FROM live_telemetry_validations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE health_ok = true)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 FROM pilot_health_checkpoints WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_observation_checkpoints WHERE criteria_met = true
